scope: Declaration-only attribution. For packages that name a licence in package.json and publish no licence text in the archive, in their source headers, or at any immutable upstream commit. The canonical SPDX text is reproduced VERBATIM including its <year> <copyright holders> placeholders; it is never interpolated with the declared holder, because that would manufacture a notice the publisher never wrote. The declared holder is recorded separately, sourced from the integrity-verified archive. This records facts and is not a determination that declaration-only attribution satisfies the licence.

textNote: `template` records whether the canonical text carries <year>/<owner> placeholders. MIT, ISC and BSD-2-Clause do; CC0-1.0 is a dedication and does not.
